CustomField.label: Product
CustomField.description: Which product this movement changed the stock of. Not enforced as schema-required because Product2 doesn't allow a Restrict/Cascade delete constraint on lookups pointing to it (a platform rule, not a choice made here) — the only delete constraint Salesforce accepts here is SetNull, which in turn cannot be combined with required=true. InventoryService always populates this on every row it creates regardless.
